teaser: Chelsea host Spurs with the easiest ride of the week, while Brighton's small army of in-form defenders runs into a wall. Gameweek 8 is about knowing which hot streaks to trust.
fullWriteup:
**Chelsea** get the kindest fixture on the board at home to Tottenham — a 2 for them, a 4 for Spurs. Coventry vs Fulham is rated kind both ways, Forest travel to Ipswich on a 2, and Brentford get a 2 at Hull. The other side of it: **Everton face a 5** at Arsenal, the worst fixture of the week, with Aston Villa, Spurs, Brighton and Bournemouth all on 4s.

The Chelsea pair are the obvious play. **Henderson** (form 10.5, £4.9m) and **Neto** (form 10.0, £6.5m) are two of the three best-scoring players in the game right now and they've got the best fixture in the game right now. **João Pedro** at 72.9% owned has form 7.0 in the same match — if you've got him, he's a captain shout. Elsewhere, **Haaland** (form 9.5) travels to Villa on a 3 and remains the safest armband, and **Mbeumo** (form 8.0) gets a 3 at home to Bournemouth. The warning sign is Brighton: De Cuyper, Vuskovic, Verbruggen and Ayari are all flying, but they go to Anfield on a **4**. Don't bring any in this week.

Differential: **Rudoni** (COV, £4.9m, form 6.5, **0.3% owned**) at home to Fulham on a 2. Cherif is the same price bracket and the same ownership if you'd rather take the forward. Either way, nobody else has them.
